title: 8 Things a Godly Man Does Before Anyone Else Is Awake
caption:
8 things a godly man does before anyone else is awake.

He prays before he checks a notification. He's moving his body while the block is still asleep. He plans the day instead of letting it happen to him.

None of it gets an audience. That's not a bug in the discipline, it's the whole point. The work that actually builds a man happens off camera, long before anyone's up to grade it.

Colossians 3:23 doesn't say work for the recognition. It says work like the only one watching is the one who matters.
